subject: [PATCH v3 2/3] mm/swap: refault on swap-in, not in the swap cache allocator

2026-08-25.patch_summary: This patch moves the evaluation of page refaults from the swap cache allocator to the two callers of swap-in functions, which read the slot's shadow before allocation overwrites it. This change prevents inflated workingset_refault_anon and workingset_activate_anon counts due to continuous writeback on certain workloads. The refault is still evaluated before adding the folio to the LRU list, ensuring that PG_workingset/PG_active flags are set correctly.
